acceptance: Internal users sign in with their AD account, no registration; role comes from the user record.
note: Prototype uses a demo email + password + OTP. Real AD/SSO needs the backend and Azure AD.

acceptance: Ends the session, returns to the login page and clears cached data.
note: Sign-out ends the session and returns to login; progress and admin data cached in the browser are not cleared.

acceptance: Concurrent login limited to a single session.
note: Needs server-side session tracking.

acceptance: Name, role/designation, team, department, email and region; ask for missing location, team and department after login.
note: First sign-in from an invite asks for missing profile details (designation, organization, region, phone) before anything else; admins see what is still missing.

acceptance: Invite one by one or upload a list; also during a training. Bulk invite can create and name a group.
note: Admin invites temporary users by email with access dates and trainings; an invite link is generated and copied. Sending the email is simulated until email (Y05).

acceptance: Start and expiry dates; start can't be in the past; set at invite, during or after training; can be extended after training ends.
Invite email contains a login link (stories) or one-time credentials (URS).
note: Invite link opens a sign-in for that person, followed by OTP and profile setup; expired or revoked invites are refused with a clear message.

acceptance: Forgot-password flow for temporary users.
note: Sign-in uses OTP with resend and expiry; invited users never set a password (D10). Real SMS/email delivery needs the backend.

requirement: Optional MFA for admins and trainers
acceptance: OTP may be enabled for Admin and Trainer roles.
note: The demo OTP step applies to everyone; needs a per-role setting and real SMS/email delivery.

requirement: Keep access to records after training
acceptance: Access lasts a pre-set time after the training ends, tied to the validity period.
note: Temporary trainees keep read access to their records and certificates for 30 days after the training by default (editable end date); access ends automatically afterwards.

acceptance: Deactivate permanent users; revoke temporary users.
note: Admins can deactivate users (Users page) and revoke temporary access; a revoked user is signed out on their next action and sees why.

requirement: Restrict permanent access to company email domains
acceptance: For example safaricom.et.

requirement: Several roles per user, highest role wins
acceptance: A user may hold multiple roles; permissions follow the highest role.
note: Still one role per demo account (learner, admin or requester); waiting on the role matrix (D8).

requirement: Turn a user into a Requester
acceptance: Toggle on the user; temporary users can't be requesters; only admins grant or revoke.
note: Users page: "Make requester" / "Remove requester", admin only, disabled for temporary users; Requesters tab and badge.

acceptance: Sees assigned materials only; no edit rights or trainee tracking.
Add users one by one or in bulk; groups appear in the request form's Target Audience.
note: Create/edit groups, add one by one, "Add all" matching a search, or paste a list of emails; groups appear as Target Audience in the request form.

acceptance: Training type, category/sub-category (multi-select with 'Other'), target audience, delivery method, location if physical, preferred date and time, participant emails (manual and bulk), objectives, optional description and file upload; validated before submit.
note: Requester form has every field, including categories and optional sub-categories from the managed list, with inline validation. Attachments keep name and size only.

requirement: Save a request as a draft
acceptance: Drafts expire after 24 hours; reopening restores every field.
note: Save draft from the form; drafts list shows time left and is purged after 24 hours; reopening restores every field.

acceptance: Names and emails for temporary trainees; size limits per file type.
note: Add one by one, paste a list, or upload CSV/TXT (name,email). Bad lines are reported; names fill in from the directory; temporary trainees must have a name. Excel files need saving as CSV.

acceptance: Pending / Approved / Rejected at each step, rejection reason visible; dashboard and email updates.
note: Requester dashboard with status counts, filter tabs, a timeline per request (Submitted → Under review → Approved/Rejected → Scheduled), rejection reason and an Updates feed. Email copies wait for Y05.

requirement: Get a join link after approval
acceptance: Link works only for portal users in the same team or organisation.
note: Join link generated on approval, shown with a copy button to the requester and admin. Restricting it to same-team portal users needs the backend.

acceptance: Same team, training type and time; a team can have several requesters.
note: Same team + training type + date is flagged while filling in, asked about on submit (warn, D13 default) and badged in the admin queue.

acceptance: Store requester ID and timestamps; notify the admin / assigned trainer.
note: Requester ID, submit time and every decision are stored in request history and the audit log; the new request appears in the admin queue. Email notification waits for Y05.

acceptance: Approve assigns a trainer; reject needs a reason from a list plus an optional comment.
note: Approve assigns a trainer and opens scheduling pre-filled; reject needs a reason from a list, plus a comment when the reason is "Other".

acceptance: Admin can make trainers approvers; trainers can't approve or assign themselves.
note: Admin can flag trainers as approvers (Approver badge). The self-approval rule applies once trainers can sign in.

requirement: Schedule a session without a request
acceptance: Title, category/sub-category, description, trainer, level, journey, pre/post assessments, delivery method, once or recurring, date and time, participant emails.
note: Schedule form: title, category/sub-category, description, type, level, journey, trainer, optional pre/post assessments, Online (Teams meeting created) or Physical with location, once or recurring, date/time, groups and participant emails, with live conflict warnings.

acceptance: Date and time, duration, training type, delivery type, location if physical.
note: Approving a request opens the scheduling form pre-filled (title, type, trainer, date, time, location, known participants) and links the new training back to the request. No trainer login yet.

acceptance: Daily, weekly or monthly; custom patterns such as every Friday at 3 PM.
note: Daily, weekly (pick weekdays, e.g. every Tue+Thu) or monthly, every N, until a date; creates one session per date in a series (max 52), with a plain-language summary and date preview.

requirement: Reschedule or cancel with a reason
acceptance: Reason from a dropdown or custom; history kept; everyone affected is notified.
note: Reschedule and cancel need a reason (dropdown or custom), apply to one session or "this and following" in a series, and are kept in Schedule history plus the audit log. Notifications are simulated until email (Y05).

acceptance: Filters for trainer, team, training type and date; colours for Confirmed / Pending / Cancelled.
note: Admin Calendar: month and agenda views; filters for trainer, team and training type; Confirmed / Pending (approved but unscheduled requests) / Completed / Cancelled colours; conflict markers; day panel.

acceptance: Trainer double-booking and trainees with overlapping sessions.
note: Trainer double-bookings and trainees in overlapping sessions are detected in the schedule form, reschedule, change-trainer and invite dialogs, on the training page, the trainings list and the calendar.

requirement: Send invites before or during a training
acceptance: Internal teams by group email, external by email, or a few people manually; copy and share the invite link.
note: Invite people or whole groups (busy trainees flagged), optional invitation email with a note, and "Copy invite link" on each session. Emails are simulated until Y05.

acceptance: Delegate to another trainer with a reason.
note: Change trainer with a required reason, for one session or the rest of the series; conflicts for the new trainer are shown and the change is kept in history.

acceptance: Individual / team schedule view with edit and filter.
Trainees see My Trainings, trainers their assigned sessions, admins everything; no cross-team access.
note: Learners see their own trainings, trainers only the sessions they conduct, admins everything; enforced in the app only until there is a backend.

requirement: Microsoft Teams join and attendance sync
note: Built on request: Join Live Training, Graph-shaped attendance with simulated data and Present / Late / Incomplete / Absent rules.

acceptance: Documents (PDF, DOCX, PPT) with minimum viewing time, images, links (YouTube, SharePoint, Google, external LMS), small videos. Attributes: level, downloadable per group, description, duration, skills, thumbnail.
note: Materials store title, type, minutes, description, level, skills, thumbnail, per-group visibility and download toggles, minimum viewing time and URL; file upload itself is simulated.

acceptance: Tagged trainers can view and/or edit.
note: Trainers sign in to a trainer portal; they can edit and replace materials they are tagged on (or create), and other materials are view-only.

acceptance: Re-upload / override (documents only) and notify trainees who have access.
note: Edit, delete and Replace file (documents/presentations) work; replacing bumps the version, appends to the version history and toasts how many trainees with access were notified.

acceptance: Sequential learning is enforced.
note: Journey builder (add, reorder, delete modules, attach materials); modules unlock in order in the learner view — each locks until the previous one is completed.

acceptance: Completion status and assigned assessments; start/end dates for the whole journey; each module unlocks after the previous one.
note: Journey start/end dates, per-module assigned assessment and unlock order are configurable; completion status is tracked per module and enforced in the learner view.

acceptance: No visibility outside the assigned group.
note: Materials carry per-group visibility and download groups; learners see a Download button only when their group is allowed, otherwise the deck is view-only in the portal.

acceptance: Title and optional description; edit existing ones. URS lists Consumer, Enterprise, Saving & Credit, Agent/Merchant, IMT.
note: Categories page: create, rename and describe categories; add, rename and remove sub-categories; in-use items can’t be deleted. Used by the schedule form and the request form (sub-categories optional).

acceptance: YouTube / SharePoint embeds, streaming only.
note: Video materials take a YouTube, Vimeo or SharePoint / Stream link (or an .mp4) and play embedded, stream-only, with a viewer watermark; the editor shows how a pasted link will play.

acceptance: View count, watch time, completion; archive older videos after X months.
Most accessed files, popular content per skill, unused content for clean-up.
note: Content tab in Reports shows views and downloads per material (seeded counters); real tracking needs the backend.

acceptance: All sessions the trainee is assigned to.
note: Trainings page with All / Active / Upcoming / Completed, calendar and detail pages.

acceptance: Documents can be marked complete after a minimum time; videos complete automatically; finishing triggers feedback.
note: Course player: lessons unlock in order; readings complete after a minimum reading time, videos complete when watched to the end; the last finished lesson can be undone.

acceptance: Upcoming sessions (calendar), completed training, scores and pass/fail, feedback status, certificates.
note: Trainings dashboard plus a course player with an outline (sections, items, locks, progress), next-step hints and "Go to next item" navigation.

acceptance: Shown at session end or when the trainer marks it complete; required before the session is Completed.
note: Feedback opens automatically once modules are done and the assessment is passed; completion (and the certificate) requires it.

acceptance: Stores the session, user ID (unless anonymous) and timestamp.
note: Learner form: four 5-point Likert statements, Yes/No recommend, optional comment and an anonymous toggle; stores training, user and timestamp.

acceptance: Question bank, custom session questions, templates per training type; 5-point Likert, Yes/No, open comments.
note: Feedback form editor: 5-point scale, Yes/No and open questions, reorder, a feedback question bank by category, and forms assigned as templates per training type (new sessions pick theirs automatically).

acceptance: Email when a score below 2.5 is submitted.
note: An alert is raised when a feedback response averages below the threshold (default 2.5, editable) and shown in the admin bell with “email queued to the training manager”. Sending email needs the backend (Y05).

acceptance: Average by question/category, session and trainer comparison, response rate, trends; filters for date, team, trainer, type, region.
note: Feedback analytics: average by question, trainer comparison, session comparison with response rate and recommend %, monthly trend, low scores; all report filters apply.

acceptance: QR code refreshing every 10 seconds, unique link, manual marking, manual input when offline.
note: Check-in panel: rotating QR (refreshes every 10s) with countdown, unique shareable link, manual marking (comment required) and offline participant-list import; Present/Late by the late window.

requirement: Check in by QR or link
acceptance: Captures timestamp, name, designation, team, email, region and attendance start–end time.
note: 'Check in' / 'Join Live Training' records the timestamp and method (Teams or manual); profile fields come from the user record.

requirement: Late window and Present / Late / Absent
acceptance: Allowed window before a check-in counts as late (e.g. 15 minutes).
note: Late window (default 15 min, editable in Settings) applies to every check-in; Present/Late is shown to learners and in reports. Repeat check-ins for long sessions not built.

acceptance: Manual entries need a comment and trainer approval; no double entries per trainee and session.
note: Manual check-ins require a comment and start unverified; the admin verifies them from the roster; one entry per trainee per session.

acceptance: Reminder X minutes after a missed check-in; re-check for multi-hour or multi-day training.
note: 'Remind N' button for not-yet-checked-in trainees (simulated toast with a reminder history); no timed reminders or re-check-in.

acceptance: Flag the training manager when a group falls below the threshold.
note: An alert is raised when a team’s attendance for a session falls below the threshold (default 60%, editable) and shown in the admin bell; email delivery is simulated until Y05.

acceptance: Filters for date, team, trainer, region, training type; Excel and PDF; by date, training or user.
note: Attendance report across trainings by training, by trainee and by date with monthly trend; all filters; Excel, CSV and PDF export.

acceptance: Set assessments as mandatory for selected courses; configure pre and post per session.
note: Assessments carry a Mandatory flag; pre/post assessments attach per training and per journey module.

requirement: Pass mark, deadline, time limit, attempts
acceptance: Minimum score, deadline, time limit and number of retakes.
note: Pass mark, deadline, time limit (whole test or per question) and max attempts are configured per assessment and enforced in the learner quiz.

acceptance: MCQs graded automatically; open answers graded by the trainer.
note: MCQ auto-graded; descriptive and file-upload questions are graded by trainers with a score and comment on the Submissions page.

acceptance: Shuffle per trainee, lock after deadline, timer per test or question, question weights, Pass/Fail or % scale, scoring notes.
note: Shuffle, lock-after-deadline, timer scope, per-question weights, score or pass/fail grading and a topic field.
Question bank tab grouped by product category with add/delete; 'Add from bank' copies questions into an assessment.
Clone copies an assessment and tags the copy with its template (templateOf) so results stay traceable to the original.

acceptance: Time allowed, number of questions, retakes.
note: Rules screen shows question count, time limit, attempts, pass mark and a shuffle notice before the learner starts.

acceptance: Score, pass/fail, trainer comments; every attempt stored with time taken.
note: Score, pass/fail and trainer comments shown; every attempt stored with start/submit timestamps on the Submissions page.

acceptance: Completion / submissions, average score, failure trends by topic; by session, trainee or overall.
note: Assessments report: attempts, average, pass rate and needs-grading per assessment, failed attempts by month and failure rate by topic, with attempt-level export.

acceptance: Attendance Present or Late, feedback completed, assessment score met.
note: Certificate requires Present/Late check-in + passed assessment + feedback; the Certificates page lists exactly what is missing per training.

requirement: Issue automatically, with a manual fallback
acceptance: Trainers issue only for sessions they conduct.
note: Automatic issuing for eligible trainees plus manual issue with a required reason (audit-logged) and reissue; trainers can issue only for sessions they conduct.

acceptance: Branded templates, assigned per training type or audience; only admins manage them.
note: Templates can be assigned to training types (one template per type, others use the default); issuing picks the template by type.

acceptance: View permission only.
note: Each admin training page lists its issued certificates (view only) with method and date; issuing happens in the tracker.

acceptance: Name, training type, issue date and official stamp.
note: Certificate page with seal; print / save as PDF.

acceptance: Eligible trainees, filters, download and reissue, sessions not yet triggered, drill-down, export.
note: Certification tracker: eligible / issued / pending per session, drill-down per trainee with attendance, feedback and score, sessions where issuing has not run, issue, reissue, download (print) and export.

acceptance: Participation, assessment performance, feedback, certificates, request status, trainer analytics, content engagement, plus general trends.
note: Reports hub with tabs: overview and trends, attendance, assessments, feedback, certificates, requests, trainer analytics and content engagement.

acceptance: Date range, training type, team/region, trainer, status, delivery mode.
note: Shared filters on every report: date range, training type, team, region, trainer, status and delivery mode; kept in the URL so a filtered report can be shared.

requirement: Export to Excel, CSV and PDF
acceptance: Anonymisation toggle for trainee-level exports.
note: Every report exports to Excel (.xlsx, one sheet per table), CSV and PDF (print layout without the app chrome); trainee-level exports can be anonymised.

acceptance: Own sessions only: calendar and pending requests, attendance %, feedback average (per session and 30 days), assessment results, content views and downloads.
note: Trainer portal dashboard: upcoming sessions, answers to grade, requests assigned to them, attendance and feedback per session and for the last 30 days, pass rate and content views; all data limited to their own sessions.

acceptance: Requested sessions and attendance of their teams.
note: Requesters get a Team reports page: sessions they requested and their team’s Present / Late / Absent per session and per trainee, with Excel/CSV/PDF export.

acceptance: Click a metric for session/user data; custom templates (HR, Finance); daily/weekly emails.
Sessions under 70% attendance, trainees missing 3+ sessions, feedback average under 2.5.
Send materials straight to groups for self-paced reading, with an optional due date and acknowledgement.
note: Materials → Assign to groups (due date, optional “I have read and understood”). Admin Assignments page shows opened / acknowledged / overdue per person, reminders and CSV export. Learners see it in Up next, the Assigned tab and the bell.

acceptance: Fix a wrong email without creating a new invitation.
note: Edit invite checks the email is valid, external and unused; changing it issues a new sign-in link (old one stops working) and can resend it. Old and new values go to the audit log.

requirement: Replace a file without re-uploading the material
acceptance: Keep the material and its links; only the file changes.
note: Replace file uses a file picker, stores name and size, bumps the version and keeps a version history; journey, training and group links stay. File contents aren't stored in the prototype.

acceptance: Admins can download files for review.
note: Download in the material menu and preview; admins always can, videos open their source. Downloads count in reports. Presentations download the bundled sample; documents a generated PDF copy.

acceptance: Without leaving the scheduling form.
note: “+ New journey” in the scheduling form opens the journey dialog and selects the new journey.

requirement: See more than five users in invitation lists
note: Invite and group lists are no longer capped at about five rows; counts and emails shown.

acceptance: A requester also sees every trainee feature.
note: Requesters get the full learner portal plus a Requests section in the same sidebar, and land on Home.

requirement: Choose any journey, in any order
acceptance: No forced sequence between journeys.
note: Journey cards at the top of Trainings filter the list; nothing is locked between journeys. Cards shrink to chips once a filter is on.

requirement: Calendar as a view of Trainings
note: Grid / list / calendar toggle on Trainings; the calendar follows the page filters. The separate Calendar tab is gone.

requirement: View user guides in the portal
note: Help & Support has searchable FAQs and three in-portal user guides; uploading guides from admin is not built yet.
Progress, certificates, favourites, read notifications and assignment status are stored per signed-in person.

acceptance: One story from request to certificate.
note: Invited people see admin-scheduled trainings (modules from the journey, quiz from the post-assessment). Check-in, module progress, scores and feedback are written back to admin attendance, grading, feedback and the certificate tracker. Videos/decks use sample files.
Download PDF saves a real A4 file; Print prints only the certificate; the QR opens a public verification page.
Learner bell (sessions, certificates, feedback, assigned reading) with preferences on the Profile page; favourites tab on Trainings.
Admin and trainer portal only; the learner portal has no dark mode yet.

requirement: Block downloads, screenshots and screen recording
note: Browsers can't reliably block screenshots; agree realistic controls (streaming only, watermarking, DRM).

requirement: Change log with before and after values
acceptance: Who made the change, the previous and new value, timestamp.
note: Audit entries keep field-level before → after values for key edits (trainings, users, materials, assessments, templates, rules, grading, manual certificates); shown in the log and exported.

requirement: Encrypt data at rest and in transit

acceptance: Only after privacy approval.
Requests, invites, reschedules, content overrides and alerts.
note: Prototype shows in-app toasts only.

acceptance: Desktop and mobile browsers.
note: Screens checked at phone width.
